commit_clusters.6cd475ae65b8: clang-builtins (CGBuiltin.cpp: index reduction for mask lanes > 32 bits, review fix)

upstream_file_edit: clang/lib/CodeGen/CGBuiltin.cpp: static EmitPULPBuiltinShuffle + 2-line dispatch at the top of EmitRISCVBuiltinExpr (same place upstream lowers its CustomTypeChecking RISC-V builtins ntl_load/ntl_store)
design: __builtin_shuffle is a PULP target builtin (BuiltinsRISCVXpulp.td, CustomTypeChecking, no feature requirement) checked with GCC's rules in SemaRISCV.cpp (new diag err_riscv_builtin_shuffle_operands). CodeGen: constant mask -> shufflevector (indices mod N/2N); run-time mask + Xpulpv + 4x8/2x16-bit -> llvm.riscv.pulp.shuffleb/shuffleh/shuffle4b/shuffle2h; otherwise generic extract/insert per lane (chosen over an error so every RISC-V config behaves like GCC). ISel: two-vector tryPulpVectorShuffle branch fixed (asserted on every input in ref-18 and int-20).

sdk_survey.why: every shuffle file is also blocked by PMSIS builtins / float16 types / other missing builtins; no __builtin_shuffle error remains except 12 fp16 files where float16 itself is unknown ('mask ... (2 vs 1)')

other_errors_seen: PRE-EXISTING MISCOMPILE (codegen-core, Xpulpv, reproduced with int-20 without __builtin_shuffle): comparing vector lanes of v4i8 selects pv.extract.b (sign-extending) for one side and p.extbz for the other, so lanes >= 0x80 compare unequal. logs/20-F019-sim/gat.c count(): 'pv.extract.b a2,a0,0' vs 'pv.shuffle.b ... ; p.extbz a3,a3; xor'. GVSoC: logs/20-F019-sim/ckonly.c, int-20 bad=796, GCC bad=0.

GVSoC (SDK gvsoc2, iss_v2 core used by ri5ky_testbench) swaps the two sources of pv.shuffle2.b/.h: lib_VEC_SHUFFLE2_8/16 in core/models/cpu/iss/include/isa_lib/int.h use their '#else' branch because iss_v2/riscv.py does not pass -DRISCV=1 (the old iss does). Selector bit set picks rD instead of rs1 (logs/20-F019-sim/probe.txt). GCC's code fails on it too. Any GVSoC oracle for code that uses pv.shuffle2 is wrong until fixed (not an LLVM problem).

GAP9 GCC 7.1.1 appears to mis-encode pv.shuffle.sci.h: for a one-vector constant v2s mask it puts the lane-1 selector in immediate bit 4 (e.g. {1,1} -> imm 17), while both GVSoC ISSes and the fork's LLVM read bit 1; GCC fails the reference on the v2s/v2u constant groups on both simulators. Worth confirming on silicon before using GCC as the oracle for halfword sci shuffles.

Perf: a constant v4i8/v2i16 operand of the PULP shuffle intrinsics (the SDK's local 'Mask' variable form) is materialised with li + pv.packhi.b + pv.packlo.b (5 instructions) instead of lui+addi (build_vector of constants is not turned into an immediate); GCC uses lui+lw.

fp16 (future float16 support): with float16=_Float16 (+zhinx) the SDK's v2h shuffles compile but not to pv.shuffle.sci.h/pv.shuffle2.h as GCC does (<2 x half> is not a PULP packed type), so the f16 FFT/MatMul shuffles are scalarised.

Side effect of the ISel fix: constant shuffles of 8 x 8-bit vectors with Xpulpv (split into two v4i8 pv.shuffle2) used to crash llc and now compile (verified on the patched GVSoC, groups c1/c2/m1/m2 v8s).

PRE-EXISTING MISCOMPILE (Xpulpv -O2, int-20 without __builtin_shuffle): a byte-by-byte FNV hash loop over a 16-byte vector (2 x long long) copied from a function result gives a different value than without Xpulpv and than GCC (logs/20-F019-sim/mixt.c, mixt.txt: 0x07a6c5d3 vs 0xf9807ad3). Likely the same family as the lane-compare miscompile; the reviewer also found that one affects v2i16/v4i16/v8i8. Should get its own backlog row.
